title: cascade-miner agent request
description: The privileged-action request an improvement pass writes to runs/agent-request.json. The controller consumes it after the pass exits and turns it into an approval-queue entry (human mode) or an allowlisted execution (autonomous mode). Writing this file never executes anything.

reason.description: Why this spend/action is needed now; shown verbatim to the approver.

candidate_path.description: Repo-relative path of the candidate this action concerns.

estimated_hours.description: Expected paid runtime; counted against the autonomy policy's hour caps.
